title: xAI Grok Voice
description: Build real-time voice applications powered by Grok. Send recorded audio and get a voice and text response.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.tooltip: URL of the audio containing the user's speech. The Grok agent listens to it and replies with speech. Most common audio formats are supported; the audio is converted to 16-bit 24 kHz mono PCM before being sent to Grok. Maximum duration 10 minutes, maximum file size 50 MB.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Optional system instructions describing the agent's persona and conversation context. Uses Grok's default persona when omitted. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: voice
inputs.tooltip: Built-in xAI voice for the agent's reply. Uses Grok's default voice when omitted. '(not set)' leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.tooltip: Typed xAI tools supported by this app's convenience configuration. Every tool is disabled in the default configuration: the searches must be switched on via their ``enabled`` flags and ``mcp_servers`` starts empty. ``file_search`` / collections are intentionally absent and unsupported due to Zero Data Retention (ZDR) requirements.
